recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in the core FHIR source unless future package-index requirements change; package generation/tooling behavior is outside this source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-28344 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by FHIR-I and asked to approve and document .index.json CodeSystem supplements and content entries so package loaders can identify supplements and content mode without loading every CodeSystem resource.
initial_application: The NPM package documentation page was introduced in c9186a64 with .index.json index-version 1 and an already documented supplements property. The explicit FHIR-28344 source commit c27bb716 changed index-version to 2 and added the content property to source/packages.html.
additional_context: The current source page is linked from source/documentation.html, so it is in the current build's documentation surface. FHIR-I minutes for 2020-09-14 record the 11-0-0 Persuasive vote, and the Zulip tooling thread only shows the package-spec proposal being routed for formal discussion, with no contrary final decision found.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source/packages.html already documents .index.json index-version 2 and includes both supplements and content in the file-entry property list.

related_jiras.note: Discussed alongside FHIR-28344 in the package-spec Zulip and FHIR-I agenda/minutes, but it concerns separate NPM package specification behavior and was not needed to decide this .index.json field audit.
